<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1233
Claimant:
Warren Fletcher
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-01-20
Claim opened for a left-turn collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck by an oncoming vehicle at an
intersection. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2024-04-12
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver, with coverage active at the time of
loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-05-01
Police report obtained, and it places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Statements from two
independent witnesses match the described sequence of events.
2024-06-01
Scene photographs and the other driver's account both confirm the collision occurred as reported. Vehicle damage is
largely consistent with the described impact, though the impact appears to have been light.
2024-06-02
Medical records received showing a wrist fracture. The injury is severe relative to the low-speed contact visible in the
photos, and the reported mechanism does not readily explain it.
2024-06-16
Records show the treatment followed a typical course, with care tapering as the claimant's condition improved. No
prior injury to the same wrist or arm appears in the available history.
2024-07-11
The claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation with the adjuster and through counsel.
No inconsistencies have been noted to date.
2024-08-11
Reviewed the vehicle's prior claim history and found no earlier damage on record. Preliminary repair estimate is being
compared against the photos for further review.
2024-08-19
File is pending a final evaluation of the injury claim against the medical records and the light-impact findings. Counsel
has been notified that a decision on the bodily injury portion will follow the review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
